verdict.rationale: The only pricing-related evidence is a feature line ('Delegate to an assistant') taken from savvycal.com/pricing. That shows a public pricing page exists listing tier features, but the pack shows no actual per-seat prices or tier breakdowns. Missing for 10: published per-seat dollar amounts, a tier-by-tier list of what each plan includes, confirmation that no sales contact is required, and independent corroboration.
